text: Tiago, it's Walter, from the shop floor. Look, I don't want to make this bigger than it is, but the press has been running hot since Tuesday. We stop it, we let it cool, we start again. It's holding, more or less. The thing is, if it stops properly, we lose a day, maybe two, and the October slot is already tight. Maintenance says they can look at it, but not before next week. Anyway. I thought you should know. I have to go, they're waiting for me.
